LanguageData.LP_Altar.label: necromantic ritual table
LanguageData.LP_Altar.description: A 3×3 necromantic ritual workbench. Add a lich ritual bill and the assigned pawn performs the transformation. Other bills serve the phylactery within 12 cells selected with the button.
LanguageData.LP_Phylactery.label: phylactery
LanguageData.LP_Phylactery.description: The lich's soul vessel. Can be carried and stored, and must be protected from destruction. Raw meat sacrifices raise its level; when the owner has an undead body, it automatically revives them 3 days after death. Keep it within 12 cells of the table for bills to serve it.
